  • Method Details

    • sevenelements$isFullySubmergedIn

      default boolean sevenelements$isFullySubmergedIn(TagKey<Fluid> fluidTag)
      Returns whether the entity is fully submerged in a fluid in fluidTag.

      This is a stricter version of isSubmergedIn, requiring the entity to be fully submerged in a fluid in fluidTag instead of just checking whether the fluid in the entity's eye level is a fluid in fluidTag.

      This method takes into account the entire height of the entity, as given by getHeight.
      Returns:
      whether the entity is fully submerged in a fluid in fluidTag
      See Also:
      • Entity.isSubmergedIn(TagKey)
